findings.title: Solver mesh is not bound to generated Gmsh mesh
findings.suggested_fix: Record a digest of each generated local.msh in the solver receipt or report and require replay to verify that digest before accepting solver logs and scalars.
findings.why_it_matters: Replay validates local.msh and the converted Elmer mesh independently, but it does not prove that either mesh is the one produced by the recorded Gmsh invocation. A retained evidence tree can therefore pair a separately valid mesh and solver log with the current deck and pass replay, making the reported temperatures stale or from another refinement.
evidence: zapote/packages/zapote-thermal/src/shunt_assembly.rs:995 -- crate::shunt_assembly_mesh::validate( validates local.msh only against geometry and node census.

zapote/packages/zapote-thermal/src/shunt_assembly.rs:1002 -- crate::shunt_assembly_mesh::validate_elmer(&d.join("mesh"), &g, &c.scenario)?; validates the converted mesh's relation to local.msh but no Gmsh input digest is recorded in the solver receipt/report.
The command receipt contract at zapote/packages/zapote-thermal/src/shunt_assembly.rs:809-828 records executable, arguments, environment, and timeout, but not the generated local.msh digest.

pre_existing_findings.title: Local replay omits invocation receipt hashes
pre_existing_findings.suggested_fix: Include gmsh, grid, and solver invocation receipt files in required_hashes and validate their command contracts during local replay, matching the assembly path.
pre_existing_findings.why_it_matters: The local thermal evidence path writes command receipts but does not hash or validate them during replay, so stale invocation metadata can survive while raw outputs are accepted.
evidence: zapote/packages/zapote-thermal/src/shunt_local.rs:364-388 -- required_hashes includes decks, meshes, logs, and scalar files but no *.command.json receipts.
zapote/packages/zapote-thermal/src/shunt_local.rs:505-543 -- replay validates backend, artifacts, decks, meshes, and measurements without reading invocation receipt files.
The omission is outside the new assembly hook and is retained as a separate local-model concern per the review scope.

residual_risks: Final solver profile and common harness run remain pending; no physical qualification claim is supported.
Concave native copper boundaries use vertex/centroid sampling plus volume/interface and gap checks rather than a general exact Boolean cell-containment proof.
External cross-model private-code egress was rejected by automatic approval review; same-provider Luna coverage is non-independent.
testing_gaps: No harness end-to-end assembly replay test supplies valid assembly evidence and asserts THERMAL.PFC.SHUNT_ASSEMBLY_NUMERICAL passes while THERMAL.PFC.SHUNT_ASSEMBLY remains indeterminate.

requirements.text: Native copper, holes, vias, materials, and solder heat ports are constructed and validated.
Energy, solver, mesh convergence, cooling, material, and heat-split sensitivity gates are implemented.
Exact source/deck/raw replay and regression tests exist, but generated Gmsh mesh identity is not digest-bound to solver evidence (finding #1).
The common harness distinguishes assembly numerical replay from assembly qualification.
Failed attempts and remaining resistor/enclosure physical uncertainty are retained in the assembly documentation.

requirements_completeness.implementation_units: No separate implementation units were listed in the explicit plan.

coverage.peer: External cross-model private-code egress was rejected by automatic approval review before this run. Same-provider Luna review is not independent cross-model verification.
notes: The P2 harness integration-test absence was demoted to testing_gaps as a testing-only gap.
P2 local replay receipt omission is pre-existing and excluded from the primary/actionable set.
Final solver profile and common harness run are pending; do not claim physical qualification.
